context:
Decide lifecycle before refactoring. If serial/run-scoped is the contract,
document it and add sequential reuse protection. If reusable/concurrent is a
product requirement, introduce a run context deliberately and slice the state
migration.
description:
Adapter instances currently behave as serial, run-scoped objects that hold
connection state, plan-capture flags, dry-run state, execution metadata, and
phase result caches. That is acceptable if documented and tested. It becomes
fragile if service-mode reuse or concurrent execution is a near-term product
goal.

This item decides the adapter lifecycle contract, adds a sequential reuse
regression test for the current model, and only introduces AdapterRunContext
if the project chooses reusable/concurrent adapters.

anti_patterns.dont: introduce AdapterRunContext just because mutable state exists
anti_patterns.why: serial run-scoped adapters may be acceptable

anti_patterns.dont: leave phase caches on self while claiming concurrency support
anti_patterns.instead: move caches into per-run context if concurrency is supported.
anti_patterns.why: that is the stale-state failure mode

anti_patterns.dont: use live cloud platforms for lifecycle tests
anti_patterns.why: optional dependencies make the guard brittle

deferrals.reason: Only required if the lifecycle decision chooses concurrent adapter reuse.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: adapter-run-context-and-reuse-contract.yaml records the decision: concurrent adapter reuse was NOT selected, so concurrency-safety work is not needed.

Do not promise concurrent adapter reuse unless tests prove the base path and representative adapters are safe.
Do not require cloud/native optional dependencies for lifecycle tests.

work_units.summary: Revalidate adapter instance state and phase cache flow

work_units.notes:
Decision recorded in docs/reference/public-contracts.md and
docs/development/adapter-refactor-map.md: PlatformAdapter instances are
serial execution objects. One instance may run multiple benchmarks
sequentially. Concurrent run_benchmark calls on one adapter are not
supported.

The base adapter owns the active per-run connection and closes it in
finally. Cached phase results, database reuse decisions, sorted-ingestion
counters, plan-capture counters, and dry-run captured SQL are run-scoped and
reset at run start. Run-config plan-capture overrides are per-run and
restored at run end; direct adapter attributes such as dry_run_mode and
table_mode remain adapter-scoped caller controls.
work_units.summary: Decision gate: serial run-scoped adapters or reusable/concurrent adapters

work_units.notes:
Implemented the serial lifecycle path. Added
PlatformAdapter._reset_run_scoped_state() and call it at the start of
run_enhanced_benchmark. The reset covers database reuse state, cached
power/throughput phase results, sorted-ingestion metadata, plan-capture
stats, plan_first_n iteration counters, and stale captured SQL when
explicit dry-run mode is active.

No AdapterRunContext was introduced because concurrent adapter reuse was
not selected for this product tier. run_config plan-capture overrides are
restored in finally so they do not leak into sequential runs.
work_units.summary: Implement the selected adapter lifecycle path
